title: Barcelona Says No To Israel! Catalan Giants Forbid Jerusalem Basketball Club From Using Their Facilities | Sports News - News18
text: Barcelona has reportedly turned down a request from Israeli basketball club Hapoel Jerusalem to train at its facilities next week, citing logistical and public order concerns. Barca’s decision The Catalan giants said Hapoel Jerusalem would not be allowed to use the Palau Blaugrana court ahead of their EuroCup game against Baxi Manresa on October 15. According to AFP , the club made the call to “avoid any problems," pointing to growing protests and security sensitivities linked to the ongoing Gaza war. The source also clarified that the Palau Blaugrana would already be undergoing preparations for a Barça handball Champions League match, which limited available space. As a result, Hapoel Jerusalem’s Spanish opponents, Baxi Manresa, have been instructed to provide their court for the visiting team’s training sessions. Rising tensions across Spain The decision comes as tensions in Spain over Israel’s military operations in Gaza continue to rise. The Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions (BDS) movement has been calling for Israeli sports teams to be barred from international competitions, including the EuroLeague and EuroCup. Another Israeli team, Hapoel Tel Aviv, is set to face Valencia Basket in the EuroLeague on the same day, and the BDS movement has demanded that match also be cancelled. Political backdrop Spain’s government has taken one of Europe’s strongest stances against Israel’s actions in Gaza. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has referred to the assault as a “genocide", and in September urged international sporting bodies to suspend Israeli teams until hostilities cease. According to Gaza’s health ministry, at least 67,183 people have been killed in the territory since Israel launched its military campaign in October 2023, following a cross-border Hamas attack that left 1,219 Israelis dead, most of them civilians. (with AFP inputs)
